sentences.en: I am actually Welsh but I am living in Bristol.
sentences.zh: 我其实是威尔士人，但目前住在布里斯托尔。

sentences.en: A Bristolian is a native of the city of Bristol.
sentences.zh: 布里斯托尔人是指布里斯托这座城市里的土著居民。

sentences.en: "I'm Bristol born and bred." "City or Rovers?" "City. City all the way."
sentences.zh: "我出生并成长在布里斯托尔。" "你是支持城市队还是罗维斯队？" "支持城市队。一路支持城市队。"
